description: Reads JUnit XML reports of test runs (Playwright, Cypress, Jest, Vitest, pytest, Surefire…), oldest first, and tells regressions from flaky tests. Each test gets a status (regression, broken, new_failure, failing, flaky, recovered), a confidence (confirmed, probable, undecided) and its evidence; failures sharing a cause are grouped, environment errors flagged. Deterministic. verdict FAIL = regression or broken in the latest run, INCONCLUSIVE = undecidable.

commits.description: Optional: the commit of each report, same order. Same-commit pass+fail proves a flake.

reports.description: JUnit XML text of each run, oldest first (1 to 50).

name: analyze_test_results
